messages:
Ava (eng): Good morning — quick async standup for canary v3.

Rolled to 5% at 03:12 UTC last night. No user-facing errors reported so far. Key points:
- Smoke: ✅ model latency steady, error rate 0.03%.
- Observed: tiny p95 bump on long prompts (~2% increase), nothing yet at p99.
- Flags: feature_flag.canary_v3 = on for 5% traffic; config PR #3842 is merged.

Ask:
- @Diego (oncall) can you confirm the TTL tweak in PR #3843 is safe to keep? :eyes:
- @Sasha can you watch SLOs for the next 4h and post any anomalous traces?
- @Ben (product) are we comfortable moving to 25% after 4h if no regressions? :thumbsup:

Ops playbook excerpt (rollback command):
```bash
# rollback to v2
redwood deploy rollback --service=inference --to-tag=v2-stable --region=us-west-2
```

I'll monitor dashboards and do a quick check-in in ~2h. Posting logs and traces here if anything pops up.

Diego (oncall): Acked — saw the TTL tweak, looks safe on staging. I'll tail the canary logs and flag any spikes. If errors > 0.5% I'll toggle the FF off and ping.

Sasha (eng-sre): Quick heads-up — set up a trace filter for `inference.generate` with sample rate 50%. p95 is +2% on long tails as you mentioned, but CPU utilization is fine. No obvious GC or OOMs. Will escalate if p99 crosses baseline.

ops-bot: deploy-bot: Canary rollout v3 @ 5% complete — commit `a1b2c3d` on infra-42. Health checks passed. Links: https://deploys/internal/rollouts/1718523456

Ben (product): OK to progress to 25% after 4h if Sasha + Diego give :thumbsup:. Hold if any customer-facing errors.

Ava (eng): Thanks. Small note — no DB migrations in this release. Blockers: none right now. Plan for today: monitor 0–4h, report back at ~07:30 UTC, if green start ramp to 25% with the staged FF flip.

Diego (oncall): Will run the automated smoke once at +90m and +3h, will post snapshots here.

Sasha (eng-sre): Adding a quick alert tweak — lowering the p99 latency alert threshold by 10% for the canary window so we catch regressions earlier.

Ava (eng): Sweet. If anyone needs to trigger rollback the command is above. Tag me on any rollbacks. :pray:

Ben (product): Thanks all. If we go to 25% let's schedule a 10-min sync to confirm metrics.

Diego (oncall): First smoke snapshot: https://logs/internal/1718523600 — looks clean. :white_check_mark:

Ava (eng): Noted, thanks everyone.
